gap: No result ChatGPT got states that a '15–17.3-inch' or '12–18.5-inch' fit range on these extenders is only a diagonal label, and that the 17.3-inch triple ChatGPT carded (FOPO S17) is sold on Amazon as working on a Mac 'Only for M1 Max/M1 Pro'. FOPO's 12–18.5-inch S788 instead runs through its UsbDisplay driver and FOPO lists base M1, M2 and M3 Macs as supported. So 'fits a 17-inch laptop' and 'shows a picture on your 17-inch laptop' are two different specs.
standout_why: I compared three rival pages that I opened. WorkCocoon's 17-inch guide gives fit only as a phrase ('fits alongside 17-inch laptops', a KEFEYA '13-17"' title). It gives no lid dimensions and doesn't say which video path each product uses. Its only DisplayPort Alt Mode mention is general advice. Cevaton's 17-inch blog gives fit only by laptop model name ('Dell XPS 17, HP Omen, MSI…'), with no dimensions, driver or Mac limits. The Office Journal triple page gives diagonal ranges only ('13-17.3"'), labels everything 'plug and play' and names no driver or chip limit. None of them sets the diagonal fit range beside the video path or the Mac chip limit. ChatGPT's own answer said 'check physical width and port requirements' and 'verify fit dimensions' but gave no figure for either.
decides: This narrows the pick rather than overturning it. On a Windows 17-inch laptop with two video-capable USB-C ports, the cheaper FOPO S17 or S15 triples (15–17.3-inch range, $199.99 / $94.99 on Amazon) are in play. On a 17-inch MacBook-class or base Apple-silicon machine, the S17 is out by its own listing, and FOPO's S788 (12–18.5-inch range, driver path, base M1–M3 listed) is the one from our linked screens that states both 17-inch fit and a way to drive two added screens. Caution for the page: among the eight screens we link, only the S788 has a maker-stated fit range that includes 17 inches. Mobile Pixels states 15–16 inches for the Trio 3 Pro and the Duex Float 2 Pro. I could not source fit ranges for the FOPO S1, S7, S11 or S9G, or for the Duex Max DS. The page rule needs at least two linked rows, so unless one of those can be sourced, this page should be a skip.
